basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a language enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I work as a freelance graphic designer which allows me the flexibility to indulge in my passion for learning languages. I'm currently focusing on Italian and love connecting with native speakers to improve. My interests also include reading science fiction, particularly in r/HFY, and keeping up with crypto developments in r/cardano. I dislike negativity and unnecessary arguments in online spaces. I am usually online during the evenings, from 7 PM to midnight, Pacific Time. I am happily married and enjoy spending weekends hiking with my partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in design, having studied at the Rhode Island School of Design. Over the years, I've developed a keen interest in languages, primarily through self-teaching and using online resources like language exchange apps. My professional work also exposes me to diverse cultures, which fuels my passion for language learning.
